decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block references from the About-page prize, ticket, and no-referral copy; no additional change is required.
The existing same-message MODIFY fully records the $5 founder, $5 affiliate, and $5 Small Block pool allocation and removes Big Block from the destination list.
The existing same-message MODIFY replaces the reward-components list with the $5 commission and Small Block ticket, fully eliminating the obsolete Big Block ticket.
The existing same-message MODIFY restricts ticket awards and counters to Small Block and removes both obsolete Big Block lifecycle keys.
The existing same-message MODIFY replaces the Mission-page prize copy with continuing $500 Small Block prizes and explicitly excludes Big Block advertising.
The existing same-message MODIFY restricts selection eligibility and scope to Small Block while preserving the source Event's continuing ticket-weighted Chainlink VRF selection model.
The existing same-message MODIFY adds the required $5 primary-mint contribution; the continuing one-winner $500 Small Block mechanism was already current and remains unchanged.
The existing same-message MODIFY removes Big Block from secondary-sale prize-pool destinations, while the source decision leaves the existing secondary-sale founder share unchanged.
The existing same-message MODIFY deletes the obsolete big_block_ticket_counter_visible key and preserves the still-valid Small Block counter and badges.
Eliminating Big Block does not change the automatic wallet-transfer collection method or payout destination for the continuing Small Block prizes.
The revenue reallocation and removal of Big Block do not change the Transak provider, fiat conversion, payment methods, or NFT mint fulfillment flow.
The badge set, referral milestones, storage, and cosmetic effects are independent of the removed Big Block prize mechanism.
